conditions: Published 2026-10-06; no CVE; description text says confirmed on 0.25.1 while metadata says < 0.31.0

notes: Stronger than R6-049: this is a published security advisory, so the version floor is a hard requirement. The vision pipeline is also touched by the EXIF site.

value: Before the fix a LoRA named foo and a base request with cache_salt=foo gave the same first-block hash, so either could reuse KV cache from the other, and a caller could choose a salt landing in an adapter's cache namespace
conditions: Merged 2026-09-30; tags components such as (lora, name) and (cache_salt, salt)
quote: Tag prefix-cache extra keys by source
notes: Confirms the 2026 year R6-049 inferred. Reinforces R6: never accept cache_salt from clients.

value: LoRA key becomes (lora, name, path). An in-place reload from the same path with changed files is still undetectable; vLLM only logs a warning. Same adapter at different absolute paths no longer shares cache blocks
conditions: Merged 2026-10-01; KV events still publish the name only
quote: Include the LoRA path in prefix-cache block hashes
notes: Design consequence: every adapter version needs a new immutable path. Overwriting a path can serve stale KV from the old weights.

value: Runtime LoRA updating warned against in production unless isolated and fully trusted; remote downloads insecure and not for production
